evidence_items.publisher: arXiv; Valentin Tablan, Scott Taylor and Kristoffer Bernhem
evidence_items.explanation: The dated public report describes a frozen-weight LLM agent retaining and applying lessons across episodes. Its outcome-only feedback condition improves single-trial success to 1.6 times the static-retrieval baseline without supplying corrected answers; methods, harness and data are reported released.

The report describes embodied language models revising actions and model parameters after execution feedback. This strengthens the case beyond external memory, but the experiment concerns specialized embodied systems and its public reproduction package is incomplete.

SEAL provides another mechanism for lasting adaptation through model-generated training material. Knowledge incorporation and few-shot adaptation alone do not establish unrestricted learning from deployment experience.
